question: Should ordinary non-heartbeat default-agent runs stop receiving HEARTBEAT.md when heartbeat guidance is enabled, or should the current documented normal-run visibility remain until a broader context-loading design lands?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing this default affects prompt/session context semantics and overlaps broader bootstrap selection proposals.

options.title: Keep Narrow Tracker Open
options.body: Track HEARTBEAT.md on-demand loading separately until maintainers decide the default non-heartbeat behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Context Design
options.body: Make a broader bootstrap/context-loading item canonical only if it explicitly covers default HEARTBEAT.md skipping before raw reads and cache snapshots.

options.title: Retain Current Contract
options.body: Keep normal-run HEARTBEAT.md visibility when guidance is enabled and close only after maintainers explicitly reject the optimization.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Tracker Open
recommendation.body: Track HEARTBEAT.md on-demand loading separately until maintainers decide the default non-heartbeat behavior.
